import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int LIM = 12;
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static char[][] g, h;
    static int[][] tim = new int[LIM][LIM];
    static int[][] dis = new int[LIM][LIM];
    static int n, t;

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < LIM; i++) Arrays.fill(tim[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        tim[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / 10, y = cur % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && g[nx][ny] >= '0' && g[nx][ny] <= '9' && tim[nx][ny] > tim[x][y] + 1) {
                    tim[nx][ny] = tim[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < LIM; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / 10, y = cur % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && h[nx][ny] >= '0' && h[nx][ny] <= '9' && dis[nx][ny] > dis[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (tim[nx][ny] >= dis[x][y] + 1) {
                        dis[nx][ny] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                        if (tim[nx][ny] > dis[nx][ny])
                            q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] head, level, it;
        ArrayList<Integer> to, nxt, cap, flow;
        int s, t, n;

        void init(int n_) {
            n = n_;
            head = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            to = new ArrayList<>();
            nxt = new ArrayList<>();
            cap = new ArrayList<>();
            flow = new ArrayList<>();
            level = new int[n];
            it = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            int id = to.size();
            to.add(v);
            cap.add(c);
            flow.add(0);
            nxt.add(head[u]);
            head[u] = id;
            to.add(u);
            cap.add(0);
            flow.add(0);
            nxt.add(head[v]);
            head[v] = id ^ 1;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = nxt.get(e)) {
                    int v = to.get(e);
                    if (level[v] == -1 && cap.get(e) > flow.get(e)) {
                        level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int a) {
            if (u == t || a == 0) return a;
            int ret = 0;
            for (int e = it[u]; e != -1; e = nxt.get(e)) {
                int v = to.get(e);
                if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && cap.get(e) > flow.get(e)) {
                    int f = dfs(v, Math.min(a, cap.get(e) - flow.get(e)));
                    if (f > 0) {
                        flow.set(e, flow.get(e) + f);
                        flow.set(e ^ 1, flow.get(e ^ 1) - f);
                        a -= f;
                        ret += f;
                        if (a == 0) break;
                    }
                }
                it[u] = e;
            }
            return ret;
        }

        int maxflow(int S, int T) {
            s = S;
            t = T;
            int ans = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                it = head.clone();
                ans += dfs(s, INF);
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        g = new char[n][n];
        h = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            g[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            h[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (g[i][j] == 'Z')
                    bfs1(i, j);

        int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow();
        mf.init(T + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9')
                    mf.addEdge(S, i * n + j + 1, g[i][j] - '0');
                if (h[i][j] > '0' && h[i][j] <= '9')
                    mf.addEdge(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, h[i][j] - '0');
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
                            if (h[x][y] > '0' && h[x][y] <= '9' && dis[x][y] <= t)
                                mf.addEdge(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
                }

        System.out.println(mf.maxflow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
